svg.title: 12 · On the screen: the dashboard fed by the bot
svg.text: 12 · On the screen: the dashboard fed by the bot
Use case: attendees in the hall see how many are here, who is in voice and what is played, live; Screen draws it from the bot's counts and Games' catalogue (screen.md widgets).
Pizza last call at 21:00 · Quiet hours from 22:00
A · Screen 1920 × 1080 (drawn at 1280 × 720), the dashboard layout, Demo night theme
Online and the graph: bot.presence.counted, built in step 3 · Voice rooms: the new bot.voice.counted · Now playing: counts per catalogue game
(names only where the zone allows) · Hot right now: games.surge.started, once the Games track builds the catalogue and surges (Q P4).
Widget catalogue: every number carries its trend arrow (10-minute averages); the live dot pulses with the count; the background is the hot game's art
under the theme's veil; a changed value gets a sweep of light; the newest bar grows live; the Next chip takes the spotlight at 5:00.
